skill_name: Compare the advantages/disadvantages between technology X and Y.
workflow: Ecommerce and brick and mortar businesses have different advantages and disadvantages. With ecommerce, customers can shop from anywhere and the business does not have to maintain a physical location. The costs associated with running an ecommerce business tend to be significantly lower than those of brick and mortar businesses.
